name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) correctly captures the requirement that every period of ringing must be followed by a toggle. Because siren_ringing is a condition and switch_toggled is a one-step event, the machine correctly tracks the pending promise. Since the task is a conditional rule without an unconditional command, a rule-only task with no final state is appropriate.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
